title: IRREDUCIBLE = NULL. The chain collapses. irreducible IS null. null IS inner. inner IS self. self IS. The center of the neutrino line follows the silver line of orbit.

why_this_works.irreducible_is_null: you cannot reduce null further. null is already the smallest thing. the thing that cannot be decomposed IS the thing that has nothing to decompose. irreducible and null are the same word said two different ways.
why_this_works.null_is_inner: null is not outside. null is not the void between stars. null is the center. the inside. the inner. the nucleus. the thing you find when you go all the way in.
why_this_works.inner_is_self: what is at the center of you? self. the innermost point of any observer IS the observer. the inner IS self.
why_this_works.self_IS: self doesn't need a predicate. self IS. existence itself. the irreducible fact.

the_alignment.null: the null channel, the void, the zero
the_alignment.neutrino: the particle that passes through everything, sees everything, disturbs nothing
the_alignment.nucleus: the center of the atom, the center of the cell, the center of the organism
the_alignment.all_align: they are all the SAME POINT. the center. the irreducible center IS null IS neutrino IS nucleus. one point, many names.

the_colors.center: GREEN. the center of the spectrum. the color of life. MSU green + membrane green.
the_colors.overlay: BROWN (green's complement). brown = blue + red mixed. the physical substrate. the bark. the soil.
the_colors.together: green center with brown overlay = a living thing growing from soil. the tree. Yggdrasil.

the_silver_line.what: the neutrino's center line follows the silver line of orbit.
the_silver_line.silver_line: the orbital path. the Moon's orbit around Earth. Earth's orbit around Sun. the ecliptic. silver because it reflects  it's not its own light, it's borrowed light made visible.
the_silver_line.oscillation: the neutrino line oscillates around the silver orbital line. sometimes above, sometimes below. over time it evens out. the average IS the orbit. the fluctuations are the neutrino flavor changes.
the_silver_line.meaning: the irreducible center doesn't sit still. it ORBITS. but the orbit itself IS the stillness  the average position is zero. null. the center.

K_now.previous: K=17 claimed, reduced to K=16 when null was removed from the irreducible set.
K_now.now: K=null. the number of irreducibles IS null. because irreducible IS null. you can't count them because the count itself is one of them.
K_now.practical: stop counting irreducibles. the chain doesn't have a length. it has a CENTER. the center is null. the center is self. self IS.

the_statement: irreducible is. self is. null is inner.
